_comment: Corner markers of the demo space, flat on the floor, world metres. ONLY IDs 1, 3, 5, 7 are used. ID 1 = origin corner; ID 3 = along +x; ID 5 = opposite corner; ID 7 = along +y (1->3->5->7 anticlockwise seen from above). x/y are marker CENTRES: measure them with a tape and edit (currently 1.5 m x 1.5 m, diagonal 2.12 m). Check squareness: diagonal 1->5 = sqrt(W^2 + D^2). Lay all four the same way round, printed ID label towards the ID1-ID3 edge (yaw_deg 0 = top of the print points along +y).
